profile.title: Profile
profile.subtitle: Personal information, learning goals and security
profile.passwordTooShort: New password must be at least 8 characters.
profile.fieldEmailHint: Your login email cannot be changed here.
profile.avatarHint: JPG, PNG or WebP, up to 5MB — you choose the crop.
profile.avatarError: Could not update the profile photo.
profile.avatarInvalidType: Unsupported format — choose a JPG, PNG or WebP image.
profile.avatarTooLarge: The image is too large — please choose a smaller one.
profile.currentLevelHint: Used to personalize your lessons — adjust it if it's off.
profile.cropHint: Drag to move the photo, use the slider to zoom in.
profile.cropAriaLabel: Avatar crop area — use the arrow keys to move, + and − to zoom.
profile.timezoneHint: Study and review reminders are sent in this time zone.
profile.birthDateHint: You can set this once — it applies the safeguards required for minors. Under 16, speaking practice waits for a parent or guardian to confirm.
profile.birthDateLockedHint: Recorded. If it is wrong, contact your centre or support.
profile.birthDateSavedMinor: Date of birth saved. Safeguards for minors now apply to this account.
profile.confirmBirthDateDesc: You are about to record {date} as this account's date of birth.
profile.confirmBirthDateDetail1: It can only be set once — you cannot change it yourself afterwards.
profile.confirmBirthDateDetail2: To correct it later, contact your centre or support.
profile.confirmBirthDateDetail3: Under 16, speaking practice stays locked until a parent or guardian confirms.
profile.sessionsDesc: Think someone else is signed in to your account? Sign out of every other device.
profile.revokedOthers: Signed out of all other devices.
profile.confirmRevokeDesc: Every other device will have to sign in again. This device stays signed in.
profile.confirmRevokeDetail1: Your phone and any other browser will be signed out.
profile.confirmRevokeDetail2: Other devices may keep access for up to 15 minutes, until their current session expires.
profile.deleteAccountDesc: Permanently delete your account and all learning data. This cannot be undone.
profile.confirmDeleteDetail1: All of your progress, submissions, scores and messages will be deleted.
profile.confirmDeleteDetail2: An active subscription is NOT cancelled automatically — cancel it in the App Store first.
profile.confirmDeleteDetail3: You will be signed out immediately and the account cannot be restored.
profile.reminderHourHint: One notification a day at this hour (in the timezone above). Leave empty for the default 18:00 reminder when you haven't studied.
profile.mfaOn: On since {date}. Every sign-in also needs a code from your authenticator app.
profile.mfaOff: Not on yet. You will be guided to turn it on at your next sign-in.
profile.mfaLow: Running low — generate a new set.
profile.mfaLoadError: Could not load the two-factor status.
profile.mfaRegenerateDesc: Enter the current 6-digit code from your authenticator app. Your old codes stop working immediately.
profile.mfaErrorCode: The code is wrong or already used. Wait for a new code and try again.
profile.mfaErrorRateLimited: Too many wrong attempts. Please try again in 15 minutes.
profile.mfaCodesDesc: Your old codes no longer work. Save these 10 codes — they are shown only this one time.
profile.mfaCodesSaved: I have saved these codes somewhere safe
profile.mfaCodesFileHeader: myDeutschFlow two-factor recovery codes. Each code works only once.
profile.securityActivityDesc: Times your password or account status changed.

securityEvents.passwordReset: You reset your password via "Forgot password"
securityEvents.passwordResetBySupport: The support team reset your password
securityEvents.supportSessionStarted: The support team started a support session
securityEvents.mfaResetBySupport: The support team reset two-factor authentication
